events.title: UniSC Sunshine Coast Graduation
events.location: UniSC Arena, 32 Olympic Way, Sippy Downs, QLD 4556
events.description: Graduation is the formal process of awarding your degree and marks your successful transition from uni student to qualified professional. To those who've helped you through it's much more than that. For your friends and family, lecturers and tutors, graduation is their time to share your success and show how proud they are of all that you've achieved.

events.title: Tax Clinic Workshop - Building long-term tax success
events.description: The UniSC Tax Clinic, in partnership with the City of Moreton Bay Business Boost Initiative, is running a practical two-hour workshop designed to help Moreton Bay small business owners move beyond the basics and build a stronger, more tax-effective business for the long term.

events.title: Coral Futures Symposium
events.description: Held in conjunction with the exhibition Coral Futures, this symposium brings together artists, First Nations knowledge holders, and researchers to explore what it means to think, imagine, and act alongside coral in a time of ecological upheaval.

events.title: Healthy brains for life
events.description: Research shows that certain lifestyle factors can reduce the risk of dementia, support cognitive function and modify brain ageing processes. Learn evidence-based strategies in this presentation to look after your brain health now and into the future. Hear from healthy ageing expert Associate Profesor Sophie Andrews.
